title: Instagram Auto Post Setup
goal: Thea can post a picture or a reel to Caleb's Instagram account on her own, with his approval of each post: the account is professional, a Meta developer app holds an Instagram business login token, the token is in the vault and refreshes itself, and one real post he approved has gone out.

project.why: Drafted 2026-09-25 by Aletheia's own model while the subscriptions were out, from something Caleb asked for. Corrected the same day by a Claude session against Meta's current documentation: switching the account to a professional account has to come FIRST (the developer app cannot see a personal account at all), the route is 'Instagram API with Instagram Login' rather than a Facebook Page, the last step he was never given was the one that actually connects it, and his step count went from four to three because she discovers the account id from the token herself. His version wins over both. Corrected again 2026-10-01 from the 2026-09-25 screens themselves: developers.facebook.com answered the app-creation attempt with the 'Create a Meta for Developers account' dialog stuck at its email code, so the block is an UNFINISHED developer registration, not a device check and not a refusal of the account; step 2 now starts with finishing it and names the two ways round a registration that loops.

steps.text: Switch the Instagram account to a professional account. This is first, and everything else fails without it: the Meta app cannot see a personal account. In the Instagram app: your profile -> the three-line menu -> Settings and privacy -> Account type and tools -> Switch to professional account -> Business.

First, finish registering as a Meta developer - this is the step nobody gave you, and it is the whole reason Business settings says 'Your account must be confirmed before you can create a new app': that Facebook account has no developer registration yet. Open developers.facebook.com/async/registration/ on your phone over mobile data (not home wifi, no VPN), press Update Email and put an inbox you actually read, enter the email code, then the phone code, then pick a role and Complete Registration. If it loops back to Contact info or the SMS never comes (Meta's forum is full of this in September 2026), add a payment method in Accounts Center -> Payments (PayPal counts; nothing is charged) and try once more - or have a friend who already has a Meta developer account create the app and add @lieutenantmemestrong under App roles -> Instagram testers, which you accept in Instagram under Settings -> Website permissions -> Tester invites. Then create the Meta developer app and generate the token, by this exact route: developers.facebook.com -> My Apps -> Create app -> any name -> use case 'Other' -> type 'Business' -> Create. In the app: Add use case -> 'Manage everything on your Instagram account' -> Add. Then API setup with Instagram business login: step 1 add the Instagram account (@lieutenantmemestrong, never the personal one), step 2 check instagram_business_basic and instagram_business_content_publish, step 3 Generate token and copy it (it starts IGAA and is shown once).

Run the one connect command at the keyboard and paste the token: python -m aletheia.instagram connect. It asks for the token without echoing it, stores it in the DPAPI vault as instagram.token, finds the Instagram account id from the token itself, and says READY only after Instagram confirms the account. Nothing else is his: the token refreshes itself before its 60 days run out.

Make the first real post: Thea publishes one picture to the account, with Caleb's approval of that specific post, and it shows in her posts ledger. That is the step that proves the whole thing works - a passing test is not it.

confirmed.words: I gave it its permission. And if it didn't give me my permission there, then boom, I'm giving it here. It has my permission. Just get this done. I don't care what it takes.
